title: Twilio API key SID and secret: secret span with companion SID
summary: A Twilio API key SID (SK + 32 hex) with its API key secret in environment assignments and in reversed order on separate lines. Values are synthetic.
rationale: Twilio uses the key SID as the Basic-auth username and the key secret as the password, and returns the secret only when the key is created. The secret span is the confidential component; the SK SID is a companion. The key secret's length and alphabet are not claimed by any source read.

expectation.rationale: Flag the API key secret span. The key resource page states that for security reasons Twilio returns the secret field only when the API key is first created and never when it is fetched; the requests page pairs key SID (username) with key secret (password). The SK SID span is a companion with no asserted outcome.

sources.supports: secret returned only at creation, never on fetch; sid pattern SK + 32 hex
sources.locator: Key resource, secret and sid properties

sources.supports: API key SID is the Basic-auth username and the API key secret is the password
